solutionSource.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

entries.clue: Who may upset Rick … (6)

indicatorNotes.upset: to upset things is to knock them into disorder

annotation.surface: Someone likely to upset a man called Rick, trailing off into the next clue.
annotation.walkthrough: Rick looks like a man's name, but a rick is a stack of hay. The ellipsis joins the surface to 5 across and plays no part in the wordplay.
annotation.definitionFit: A haymow is a heap of hay, which is exactly what a rick is.

entries.clue: Sky link to publicise game (3-6)

blocks.note: to air a view is to publicise it

annotation.surface: A link in the sky being used to promote some game.
annotation.walkthrough: An air-bridge is a regular air service linking two places, a link through the sky.
annotation.definitionFit: An air-bridge is a link between places made by aircraft.

entries.clue: Note about metronome set for Danse macabre? (7,4)

indicatorNotes.about: 'about' means around, so MI surrounds the other letters
indicatorNotes.set: to set things is to arrange them anew

blocks.note: mi, the third note of the sol-fa scale

annotation.surface: A musical score for Saint-Saëns's Danse macabre with its metronome marking.
annotation.walkthrough: The musical surface hides the real sense: the danse macabre, skeletons dancing with the living, is a reminder of death, as a memento mori is. MI splits so M opens and I closes the answer.
annotation.definitionFit: The danse macabre is an allegory reminding everyone that they must die, which is what a memento mori does.

entries.clue: Writer Pound probing texture (5)

blocks.note: woof is the weft of a woven fabric

annotation.surface: The poet Ezra Pound examining the texture of a text.
annotation.walkthrough: Pound pairs with Writer to suggest Ezra Pound, but it is just the pound sign L. Virginia Woolf is the writer.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain example: Virginia Woolf, the novelist of Mrs Dalloway, stands for the general 'Writer'.

entries.clue: … proud leader in the Levant? (8)

indicatorNotes.in: one piece sits in the other

blocks.note: the Levant is the eastern Mediterranean: E + MED

annotation.surface: A proud ruler somewhere in the Middle East.
annotation.walkthrough: Proud here means standing out from a surface, as raised lettering does. The Levant has to be abbreviated as E MED to take BOSS inside.
annotation.definitionFit: Embossed work is raised, or proud, of the surface around it.

entries.clue: Losing position, historian better entertained here? (5)

indicatorNotes.Losing: what is lost is taken away

blocks.note: Thomas Babington Macaulay, the Victorian historian
lay = position, as in the lay of the land; this is removed

annotation.surface: A historian losing his position, perhaps better off taking his mind off it somewhere.
annotation.walkthrough: Better means one who bets, not an improvement. Macau is the gambling capital of the Far East.
annotation.definitionFit: Macau is famous for its casinos, where a gambler is entertained.

entries.clue: Longer and shorter periods written up in last letter (5)

indicatorNotes.written up: in a down clue, writing upwards turns the letters round

blocks.note: an age is a long period

annotation.surface: Some periods of time being written up in a final letter.
annotation.walkthrough: Periods serves both halves: a longer period (AGE) and a shorter one (MO).
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by position: omega closes the Greek alphabet, just as 'last letter' says.

entries.clue: Mystic Laplander importing whiskey (5)

indicatorNotes.importing: a country importing goods brings them in, so SAMI brings W inside

blocks.note: the Sami are the people of Lapland
W is whiskey in the NATO alphabet

annotation.surface: A Lapland mystic smuggling in some whiskey.
annotation.walkthrough: A swami is a Hindu religious teacher.
annotation.definitionFit: A swami is a Hindu holy man or mystic.

entries.clue: Kitchen item in drawer perhaps in restaurant (7)

indicatorNotes.in: one piece goes in the other

blocks.note: RA = Royal Academician, an artist who draws

annotation.surface: A kitchen utensil kept in a drawer at a restaurant.
annotation.walkthrough: Drawer looks like a piece of furniture; it is someone who draws, and the perhaps marks RA as one example of such an artist.
annotation.definitionFit: A drainer is a rack or colander used in the kitchen.

entries.clue: Black sheep first to feature in company game (6)

indicatorNotes.to feature in: to feature in something is to appear inside it

blocks.note: a ram is a male sheep; 'first' puts it ahead of the black

annotation.surface: The black sheep of the family being the first to join in a party game.
annotation.walkthrough: Black sheep looks like an idiom but splits in two, and 'first' says the sheep comes before the black: RAM then B.
annotation.definitionFit: Crambo is a word game in which players find rhymes.

entries.clue: Plans as heartless Macbeth may shape? (8)

indicatorNotes.heartless: the heart, the middle letter, is removed
indicatorNotes.shape: to shape letters is to form them into something new

blocks.note: MACBETH without its middle letter B

annotation.surface: Plotting the way a ruthless Macbeth might.
annotation.walkthrough: Heartless reads as describing Macbeth's cruelty, but it removes the central B of his name.
annotation.definitionFit: Schemata, plural of schema, are outlines or plans.

entries.clue: Festival time: no fruit with sangria strangely (15)

indicatorNotes.strangely: the letters are arranged in a strange way

annotation.surface: A festival where the sangria is served without any fruit in it.
annotation.walkthrough: The Transfiguration is a Christian feast on 6 August, not the kind of festival the sangria suggests.
annotation.definitionFit: The Transfiguration is a feast in the church calendar, so 'Festival' is the religious sense rather than a music event.

entries.clue: Torment involves Bill having turned to Satan? (4,3)

indicatorNotes.involves: to involve is to wrap up inside

blocks.note: neb = a bird's beak or bill

annotation.surface: Someone tormented by a debt who ends up in league with the devil.
annotation.walkthrough: Bill is neither a debt nor a man but a bird's beak. The definition plays on turned: milk that has gone bad has turned, and so has a soul turned to Satan.
annotation.definitionFit: Milk that has turned has gone bad; a soul turned to Satan has gone bad in the moral sense, hence the question mark.

entries.clue: Boozer cancelled in Plato’s work for scrap (5)

indicatorNotes.cancelled in: what is cancelled is struck out from inside

blocks.note: a boozer is a pub; it is removed

annotation.surface: A drunk dismissed from Plato's great dialogue for being rubbish.
annotation.walkthrough: Boozer looks like a drinker; it is British slang for a pub.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: a relic is a scrap left over from the past, a remnant.

entries.clue: Present ploy finally decisive in long-term investment? (6,5)

annotation.definition: Present ploy finally decisive in long-term investment?

blocks.note: reads as a current tactic; really a gift that was a trick
reads as finance; really investment in the military sense, a siege, here the ten-year siege of Troy that the wooden horse ended

annotation.surface: A financial gift that finally pays off in a long-term investment.
annotation.walkthrough: Investment is the military sense, a siege: the wooden horse was the gift and trick that ended the ten-year siege of Troy.
annotation.definitionFit: The Trojan horse was a gift used as a ploy that finally won the long siege of Troy.

entries.clue: An academic keeping promises is right for the church (8)

indicatorNotes.keeping: to keep something is to hold it inside

blocks.note: a don is a university teacher

annotation.surface: A lecturer who keeps their word is just right for a career in the church.
annotation.walkthrough: An advowson is the right to nominate a parish priest, an old English legal term.
annotation.definitionFit: An advowson is the right to present a clergyman to a church living.

entries.clue: Rope fixed with ambassador coming aboard (5)

indicatorNotes.coming aboard: to come aboard is to get inside

blocks.note: HE = His Excellency, an ambassador's title

annotation.surface: A rope being secured as the ambassador boards the ship.
annotation.walkthrough: A sheet on a boat is a rope controlling a sail, not a piece of canvas.
annotation.definitionFit: Sailing sense: on a boat the ropes that control a sail are called sheets, not the sail itself.

entries.clue: Get new working implements back for criminal (6)

indicatorNotes.back: going back turns the word round

blocks.note: to retool is to equip with new tools

annotation.surface: Criminal ways of getting fresh tools for the job.
annotation.walkthrough: The whole phrase 'Get new working implements' defines RETOOL, which read backwards is the answer.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: a looter steals goods, usually amid disorder, and so is a criminal.

entries.clue: Issue beginning to engage mother country (9)

indicatorNotes.beginning to: the beginning of a word is its first letter

annotation.surface: An issue that starts to involve a mother country and its colonies.
annotation.walkthrough: Mother country looks like one phrase, but it splits into two separate pieces.
annotation.definitionFit: An emanation is something that issues from a source.

entries.clue: Hieronymus I in French Catholic Church (6)

blocks.note: Rome stands for the Roman Catholic Church

annotation.surface: A Latin-named figure placed in the French Catholic Church.
annotation.walkthrough: Hieronymus is the Latin form of Jerome, the saint who translated the Bible into Latin. In French looks like a location; it translates I.
annotation.definitionFit: Hieronymus is the Latin name of Saint Jerome.

entries.clue: Sink white ball at first: all to play for? (7)

blocks.note: the jack is the small white target ball in bowls, placed 'at first'
to pot a ball is to sink it

annotation.surface: Potting the white ball in snooker when everything hangs on the shot.
annotation.walkthrough: The snooker picture of sinking the white is a trap: the white ball is the jack from bowls, and 'at first' moves it to the front.
annotation.definitionFit: The jackpot is the whole prize that players are competing for.

entries.clue: Ace with two clubs a roguish child holds in game (8)

indicatorNotes.holds: to hold is to have inside

blocks.note: a brat is a naughty child

annotation.surface: A cheeky child clutching the ace and two clubs in a card game.
annotation.walkthrough: The card picture fits the answer, a casino card game, but the cards are only letters.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by example: baccarat is one particular casino card game.

entries.clue: Power kept by the Cardinal and his converted sect member (15)

indicatorNotes.kept by: what is kept is held inside
indicatorNotes.converted: to convert is to change into something else

annotation.surface: A cardinal and the religious converts under his sway.
annotation.walkthrough: Converted suits the religious surface but is the anagram indicator. The Christadelphians are a small Bible-based Christian sect.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by example: the Christadelphians are one specific Bible-based sect, so a Christadelphian is a sect member.

entries.clue: Inspired poet from Dublin bringing down leader? (5)

indicatorNotes.bringing down leader: in a down clue, the first letter is moved to the bottom

annotation.surface: A Dublin poet with a political edge, perhaps toppling the leader.
annotation.walkthrough: A rishi is a Hindu sage or inspired poet; the question mark nods to Rishi Sunak, a leader who was brought down.
annotation.definitionFit: In Hinduism, a rishi is an inspired poet or seer of the Vedas.

entries.clue: Piece of plant entirely extracted from leek (5)

indicatorNotes.extracted from: what is extracted is taken out

annotation.surface: Cutting a piece off a leek in the kitchen.
annotation.walkthrough: Scallion is used for leeks as well as spring onions.
annotation.definitionFit: A scion is a shoot or cutting taken from a plant for grafting.

entries.clue: A ring for a bunch of keys? (5)

annotation.surface: A key ring to hold a bunch of keys.
annotation.walkthrough: Keys here are low islands, like the Florida Keys, and an atoll is a ring of them round a lagoon.
annotation.definitionFit: An atoll is a ring of coral islands, or keys.

entries.clue: Spooner’s need initially discussed in two Parisian articles (5)

indicatorNotes.in: one piece goes in the other

annotation.surface: The Reverend Spooner's needs being discussed in French.
annotation.walkthrough: Spooner is not setting a spoonerism here; he is simply someone who needs a spoon, and a ladle is one.
annotation.definitionFit: A ladle is a large spoon, which a spooner would need.

entries.clue: Attitude I put on for god (8)

blocks.note: to don clothes is to put them on

annotation.surface: Striking an attitude to look like a god.
annotation.walkthrough: Put on looks like the pose being faked; it is DON, as with clothes.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by example: Poseidon is the Greek sea god, one god among many.

entries.clue: Scientist reversing excellent success (6)

indicatorNotes.reversing: the word is turned back to front

annotation.surface: A scientist overturning a successful result.
annotation.walkthrough: Charles Darwin, whose theory of evolution overturned received ideas.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by example: Charles Darwin, the naturalist behind natural selection, is one scientist.

entries.clue: Seaweed wraps around Rhode Island figure (8)

indicatorNotes.wraps around: to wrap around is to enclose

blocks.note: tangle is a kind of kelp

annotation.surface: Seaweed washed up around the shores of Rhode Island.
annotation.walkthrough: Tangle is a less familiar name for a large brown seaweed.
annotation.definitionFit: Geometric sense: figure means a shape here, and a triangle is one such shape.

entries.clue: Bird in Central Greece unchanging in poems (6)

indicatorNotes.Central: the central part of a word is its middle, here the two Es at the centre of GREECE
indicatorNotes.in: one piece goes in the other

blocks.note: the middle two letters of GREECE

annotation.surface: A bird of central Greece that never changes in the poets' verse.
annotation.walkthrough: In poems marks ETERNE as a poetic form of eternal.
annotation.definitionFit: Eterne is an archaic, poetic word for eternal or unchanging.
